description: MudPopover #13635 - before/after AppBar z-index fix

Rebuilt a popular AI recruiting workflow with security controls the original lacked: prompt-injection scanning, output schema validation, PII minimization, per-sender rate limits, Slack approver identity checks, 90-day retention purge, error alerting. Ships as an importable n8n JSON plus a written threat model mapping every control to a specific finding. Built to show clients what "production-ready AI automation" actually requires, not just what a demo needs.
